shots.heading: EXT. AETHER PEAKS – DAWN
shots.action_description: Zephyr stands at the cliff’s edge, wings folded, listening to a distant rumble rising from the valley.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Silver‑blue Zephyr on frost‑covered cliff at dawn, low angle, lavender sky, cinematic lighting.
shots.out_frame_still_prompt: Wide aerial of jagged cliffs above cloud sea, soft dawn light.
shots.video_prompt: Slow dolly toward Zephyr, subtle wind effects, atmospheric cloud drift.

takes.camera_instruction: Low angle dolly from 12 feet back, keep Zephyr centered.
takes.init_seed_guidance: High detail on scales, crisp dawn lighting.
takes.in_frame_still_prompt: Low‑angle still of Zephyr, frost foreground, lavender sky.
takes.out_frame_still_prompt: Static wide shot of Aether Peaks with drifting clouds.
takes.video_prompt: Forward dolly into Zephyr, subtle wind motion.

shots.heading: EXT. AETHER PEAKS – CONTINUOUS
shots.action_description: Zephyr’s eyes narrow as the rumble intensifies. Wind coils around him, responding to his rising resolve.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Close‑up of Zephyr’s eyes glowing with storm‑light, wind curling around snout.
shots.out_frame_still_prompt: Distant valley with faint rising dust plume.
shots.video_prompt: Push‑in to Zephyr’s face as wind intensifies.

takes.camera_instruction: Push‑in from medium to tight close‑up.
takes.init_seed_guidance: Emphasize eye glow and wind motion.
takes.in_frame_still_prompt: Tight close‑up of Zephyr’s glowing eyes.

shots.heading: EXT. AETHER PEAKS – CONTINUOUS
shots.action_description: Zephyr leaps off the cliff. Wings snap open with a thunderous crack as he dives toward the valley.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Zephyr launching off cliff, wings unfurled, dramatic dawn sky.
shots.out_frame_still_prompt: Cliff receding behind camera, clouds below.
shots.video_prompt: Crane drop following Zephyr’s leap, wings opening mid‑fall.

takes.camera_instruction: Follow Zephyr’s descent with crane drop, then rise as wings open.

shots.heading: EXT. WINDHAVEN VALLEY – MORNING
shots.action_description: A windmill tower cracks and begins to fall toward a group of children.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Windmill collapsing, villagers running, dust clouds rising.
shots.video_prompt: Lateral tracking shot following falling windmill.

shots.heading: EXT. WINDHAVEN VALLEY – CONTINUOUS
shots.action_description: Zephyr dives from the sky, spiraling into a glowing helix of wind as he races toward the falling tower.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Zephyr spiraling downward, wind vortex forming around him.
shots.video_prompt: High‑speed aerial dive with spiraling wind effects.

takes.init_seed_guidance: Strong motion blur, wind helix clarity.

shots.heading: EXT. WINDHAVEN SQUARE – CONTINUOUS
shots.action_description: Zephyr unleashes a burst of compressed wind, freezing the falling windmill mid‑air and lowering it gently.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Zephyr holding windmill suspended in cyclone, children watching.
shots.video_prompt: Cyclone stabilization effect as tower lowers.

takes.camera_instruction: Hold static telephoto on Zephyr and suspended tower.

shots.heading: EXT. VORTEX CORE – CONTINUOUS
shots.spoken_dialogue: MAELSTROM: You cannot stop the storm, Skyborn.
shots.action_description: The vortex pulses violently as Maelstrom emerges, wrapped in dark winds.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Storm mage emerging from vortex, lightning arcs, swirling winds.
shots.video_prompt: Whip‑pan into Maelstrom’s reveal with lightning bursts.

shots.heading: EXT. VORTEX CORE – CONTINUOUS
shots.spoken_dialogue: ZEPHYR: I don’t stop storms. I guide them.
shots.action_description: Zephyr lowers his horned crown, eyes glowing as he prepares to counter Maelstrom’s magic.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Zephyr framed over Maelstrom’s shoulder, eyes glowing.

shots.heading: EXT. VORTEX CORE – CONTINUOUS
shots.action_description: Zephyr channels the Gale Stone, forming a glowing sphere of compressed wind. He launches it, shattering the vortex.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Zephyr unleashing wind sphere, vortex cracking apart.
shots.video_prompt: Orbiting crane shot around Zephyr as vortex collapses.

takes.camera_instruction: Orbit around Zephyr as he fires wind sphere.

shots.heading: EXT. WINDHAVEN VALLEY – AFTERMATH
shots.spoken_dialogue: ZEPHYR: Just Zephyr. Protector of the winds.
shots.action_description: Villagers gather around Zephyr. A child hands him a carved wind emblem. Zephyr bows his head.
shots.in_frame_still_prompt: Zephyr surrounded by villagers, child offering emblem, warm morning light.
shots.video_prompt: Slow push‑in as Zephyr accepts emblem.

takes.camera_instruction: Push‑in from medium to close‑up on Zephyr and child.
